verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents an official CLI at docs.coderabbit.ai/cli/. It runs AI code reviews before you commit, works with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, and can run in CI/CD pipelines, which fits an AI-native workflow. A probe confirmed the CLI documentation exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use, and evidence of the CLI's command surface and install details.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Get AI code reviews directly in your CLI before you commit.
integrate seamlessly with your AI coding agents, or run reviews in CI/CD pipelines.
Claude Code can trigger CodeRabbit reviews directly through simple commands
